page.layout: One page of text: running head at top; a bold heading in two lines above a woodcut engraving; below the engraving a verse emblem in italic lines with a dropped initial; closing word at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: tes, vnus antecedentem, alter à tergo
[woodcut engraving: two men walking in a landscape, one casting a shadow behind him, sun above]

l.i: SEctantes velut Vmbra fugit, fugientibus instat,
Sic fugit immerita captantes pramia laudis,
Et tamen haud falso trutinata examine,
Laus hæc omnis erit? scilicet Vmbra leuis.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving described in the main text, not transcribed. The initial S of the emblem is a large decorated letter. Running head and heading are printed in spaced capitals and larger type. Possible misreadings in the italic verse: "Sectantes" and "Vmbra" read as printed; "pramia" is as printed. The final word "Hydro-" is a catchword line, hyphenated at the foot.
